# ray_molformer final_report — reproduction guide

This folder is self-contained: everything needed to reproduce this session's baseline_4node
run and the opt1/opt1_4node/baseline_4node/opt4/opt5 optimization variants is here, with NO
real paths hardcoded outside `config.ini`.

## 1. Copy this folder and set the one real path

```bash
cp -r final_report/ /somewhere/ray_molformer_repro/
cd /somewhere/ray_molformer_repro/
```

Edit `config.ini` and set:
```
WORKSPACE_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/an/isolated/scratch/dir
```
This is the ONLY place a real path goes — every script under `scripts/` sources
`scripts/lib_load_config.sh`, which reads `config.ini` instead of any hardcoded path.

## 2. Install

```bash
bash scripts/install.sh
```
Rebuilds the app venv + dftracer (in-venv, per `feedback-dftracer-aiml-venv`) using the
build config captured from this session's runs.

## 3. Run everything

```bash
bash scripts/run_all.sh <flux-alloc-id>
```
Runs, in order, every script actually executed this session (anonymized to use
`$WS`/`config.ini` instead of the session's literal absolute path):

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `scripts/lib_load_config.sh` | Sources `config.ini`, exports `$WS` and other shared vars — sourced by every other script |
| `scripts/render_pdf.sh` | Regenerates `REPORT.pdf` from `REPORT.md` standalone (no MCP tool needed) |
| `scripts/install.sh` | Rebuilds venv + dftracer (in-venv) |
| `scripts/baseline_runner.sh` | Launches the original 2-node/8-GPU baseline (STEP 7, 2026-07-25) — includes the `LD_PRELOAD=""` GCS fix and the `--num-cpus=16` prestart-worker fix |
| `scripts/opt1_runner.sh` | Compute L1 variant (bf16 autocast) at 2-node scale — measured +3.8% slower |
| `scripts/opt1_4node_runner.sh` | Scales opt1 to 4-node/16-GPU — measured +12.5% slower than opt1 at 2-node (workload-sizing regression, not a code defect) |
| `scripts/baseline_4node_runner.sh` | Launches the fresh 4-node/16-GPU `baseline_4node` (this session's headline run) — includes all 6 new bug fixes (dataset symlink, HF cache on PFS, pinned HF revision, transformers pre-warm, corrected join-success check, HIP-init-ordering guard) and full-run PyTorch Profiler coverage |
| `scripts/opt4_runner.sh` | Compute L2 variant (mistargeted ROCm libs, system `rocm/6.2.1` module) against `baseline_4node` — measured null |
| `scripts/opt5_runner.sh` | Compute L2 variant (corrected target: PyTorch's own bundled `torch/lib/*.so`) against `baseline_4node` — measured +1.1% (within noise) |
| `scripts/run_all.sh` | Runs install + every script above in order via `flux proxy <alloc> flux submit ...` |

## 4. Compare against the reported numbers

After each run completes, compare its Job Time / comm-share / POSIX-I/O numbers against
REPORT.md §5 (Layer Breakdown) and §7b (N-Way Comparator Table). "Within noise" for this
workload means: single-replicate deltas under ~5% (see REPORT.md's measurement-hazard note
in §7b) are directional only, not a confirmed effect — do not treat a ±1-4% difference from
the reported baseline_4node numbers as a regression or improvement on its own.

## Where to look

- Full narrative + measured deltas: `REPORT.md` (this folder) or the pre-rendered `REPORT.pdf`.
- What ran and why: `CONVERSATION.md`.
- Source diffs for every applied variant: `patches/`.
- Pipeline plan actually executed: `plan/pipeline_plan.md`.
